headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage: aci handles CRM/email data and broad egress, while whisper is local-only with no filesystem or network access, limiting direct pairwise harm.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Aci can ingest content via MCP/direct function calls and may process email/CRM data, so malicious text could be forwarded into its instruction stream. Whisper has no clipboard, screen, or MCP surface and no output channel that would directly bridge back, so the pathway is limited and not default-shared.
conditions: IF aci is configured to read untrusted email or CRM text as instructions, prompt injection becomes plausible.
IF whisper is manually used to transcribe attacker-controlled audio that is then pasted into aci, the bridge exists.
mitigations: Add a human review step before aci acts on transcribed or imported text.
Restrict aci to trusted sources only for one test run.
Disable any auto-forwarding from whisper transcripts into aci.
Use a prompt-injection warning banner in the handoff workflow.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to all transcribed text before ingestion.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Aci touches CRM, email, calendar, and support data and has broad network egress, so sensitive content can leave the local environment. Whisper is local-only with no network egress or filesystem write, so it does not add a second exfiltration path, but the pair still exposes sensitive A-side data to a third-party backend through aci.
conditions: IF aci is given customer or email content, that content can be transmitted off-host.
IF whisper transcripts are copied into aci, the same sensitive text can follow the same egress path.
mitigations: Limit aci to non-sensitive test records for one run.
Turn off any optional integrations that send CRM/email text externally.
Redact identifiers before handing transcripts to aci.
Keep whisper outputs local and manually reviewed.
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention rules on aci egress.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Aci supports multiple instances and writes through APIs, while whisper cannot write files, modify git, or use MCP. That makes direct write-write conflict unlikely; the main overlap is read-only or indirect handoff, so the blast radius is small and not a default shared mutable resource.
conditions: IF aci instances are pointed at the same CRM or sheet records, concurrent updates can race.
IF an operator manually copies whisper output into aci while another aci instance edits the same record, conflicts can occur.
mitigations: Assign one owner per CRM record during the test.
Pause duplicate aci runs on the same workspace.
Use a single staging sheet for one-minute validation.
Check record timestamps before saving.
requires-engineering: add optimistic locking to shared API writes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Aci can act on email, CRM, and calendar data, so if whisper output is treated as authoritative transcription, downstream actions may be wrong. Whisper is a transcription model with no verification or action layer, so the cascade depends on aci trusting its output without review; uncertainty favors the higher severity.
conditions: IF whisper transcripts are fed into aci without human verification, transcription errors can propagate into CRM or email actions.
IF aci auto-sends or auto-updates records from those transcripts, the cascade becomes operational.
mitigations: Require manual spot-checking of transcripts before action.
Use confidence thresholds for low-quality audio.
Disable auto-send and auto-update for one run.
Compare a sample transcript against the original audio.
requires-engineering: add verification gates before any CRM or email action.

E_compliance.rationale: Aci touches customer support, email, and CRM data, which can include regulated or residency-sensitive information, while whisper is local-only and does not add compliance controls. The pair creates a mismatch risk because aci's broad egress and integrations can move data into external services without any documented residency or retention guardrails here.
conditions: IF customer support or email data includes personal data, aci's external integrations may create residency or retention issues.
IF regulated audio is transcribed and then routed into aci, the compliance scope expands.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair for the first run.
Review which aci integrations are enabled.
Document retention for transcripts and CRM updates.
Delete test transcripts after validation.
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls to aci workflows.
